definition: Combined rated annual capacity of active polysilicon records in the DOE map
limitation: Nameplate is not output; product grade and allocation to solar are not reported

definition: Combined rated annual capacity of active wafer records in the DOE map
limitation: Nameplate is not output; ramp and yield are not reported

definition: Combined rated annual capacity of active crystalline-silicon cell records in the DOE map
limitation: Nameplate is not output and does not identify wafer origin

definition: Crystalline-silicon cell import quantity reported by USITC
limitation: Direct import origin does not reveal the wafer or polysilicon origin

definition: Combined rated annual capacity of active module records in the DOE map
limitation: Computed total depends on DOE record coverage and is not actual output
calculation: Sum of 39 active module manufacturing records

definition: Crystalline-silicon module import quantity reported by USITC
limitation: Does not expose the origin of embedded cells and materials

definition: China share of estimated global crystalline-silicon wafer production
limitation: Global production concentration is not the same as direct U.S. import origin

definition: Utility-scale PV additions developers planned for 2026
limitation: Planned additions are not completed installations and are shown separately from historical demand
